# go-modern-slices-contains

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use slices.Contains instead of a manual search loop.

## Details

slices.Contains is the direct membership test for slices of comparable values.
It replaces a manual search loop whose only result is whether the element is present.

## Examples

### Before

```go
found := false
for _, item := range items {
  if item == x {
    found = true
    break
  }
}
```

### After

```go
found := slices.Contains(items, x)
```
